text:
ada: Observed a 22% throughput drop on variant-aware routing after yesterday's continuous-batching tweak. Appears when requests mix v1/v2 variants with long seqs. perf-bot posted alert too. :thinking:

sam: Where's the profiler output? is KV hit rate lower?

ada: Quick excerpt from pprof (filtered):
```
serving/runtime/scheduler: batch formation spikes + increased fanout
kernel: 45% time spent on attention kernel A vs 30% baseline
kvcache: hit_rate 0.61 (was 0.88)
queue: avg_wait_ms 42 -> 78
```

mike: hm, fans out because compat sets split v1/v2; more fragments => smaller batches. Could be our 'prefer-compat' threshold lowering merges. What were token_budget targets?

ada: token_budget_target=128 per batch; used to be 160 for this pool. Change rolled by canary at 04:10 UTC.

nina: also saw fallbacks to quantized variants on capacity pressure, which invalidate KV entries (different cache keys). That would explain KV hit_rate drop.

sam: can you paste the queue policy chunk from the rollout? need to see priority/aging.

ada: copy:
```
queue_policy {
  max_wait_ms: 100
  token_budget_target: 128
  allow_cross_compat_merge: true
  compat_merge_threshold: 0.6
}
```

mike: try 3 quick probes:
- bump token_budget_target -> 160
- disable allow_cross_compat_merge (force same-variant merges)
- pin fallback_map so quantized variants only used under 90% GPU util
I'll run load test A with multi-model mix.

nina: also add a TTL to KV keys that include variant id so fallbacks don't invalidate general keys; short-term patch: keep canonical keys for shared embeddings.

perf-bot: [ALERT] regression detected on pool 'eu-west-1/gpu-large' +22% latency p95, ticket #INC-2026 created.

ada: assigning: mike -> run probes, sam -> gather detailed traces from 04:00–05:00 UTC, nina -> KV key TTL quick patch. I'll revert token_budget canary if probes fail. :eyes:

sam: ack
mike: will run probes in 20m and post results
nina: starting patch PR now

ada: thanks — let's sync in 1h in #eng-runtime if we have results.
